categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and changes connection management in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where offline nodes overwrite anchors.dat with an empty list and drop anchor addresses, preserving eclipse attack mitigations across restarts. The PR ensures active block-relay connections are cached and not prematurely consumed when network activity is disabled, protecting an essential partition-resistance mechanism in P2P connection handling.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Does not modify any RPC files, interfaces, or RPC handling machinery.
categories.rationale: While setnetworkactive triggers the scenario, the change resides entirely in net.cpp connection management and does not alter RPC behavior or interfaces.
